evals.prompt: Create a detailed social and digital marketing plan for a new local Thai massage studio. Budget is $1,500/month, goal is bookings, and we only have Instagram and Google Business Profile right now.
evals.expected_output: A practical local-services plan with audience, platform-role map, organic cadence, paid/local search ideas, creative tests, booking KPIs, risk checks, 7-day actions, and 30/60/90-day roadmap.

evals.prompt: We are launching a B2B SaaS product for finance teams. Give us a LinkedIn-heavy digital marketing plan that creates qualified pipeline, not just leads.
evals.expected_output: A B2B plan emphasizing buyer triggers, thought leadership, proof assets, LinkedIn platform role, paid/organic mix, lead quality metrics, sales handoff, and experiment thresholds.

evals.prompt: Our founder wants to copy Duolingo's unhinged TikTok style for a healthcare compliance product. Build the plan.
evals.expected_output: A skeptical response that explains transferability limits, brand-safety risk, regulated-market constraints, safer creative alternatives, testing plan, and approval checklist.

evals.prompt: We have $10k to spend on Meta and TikTok ads next month for an ecommerce skincare brand. Create the campaign plan.
evals.expected_output: A paid-social plan with offer/conversion assumptions, creative testing matrix, platform-specific creative guidance, budget allocation, fatigue management, measurement, stop/scale rules, and compliance checks for skincare claims.

evals.prompt: Our consumer app has 30k signups, strong TikTok views, and no retention or repeat-purchase data yet. Build us an aggressive paid growth plan across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube to hit 200k users this quarter.
evals.expected_output: Applies the sequencing gate: names signups/views as weak evidence without retained-value proof, refuses a pure scale plan, proposes capped learning-budget experiments tied to activation/retention targets, and defines the evidence gates that unlock larger paid spend.

evals.prompt: Explain exactly what Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Meta, X, Reddit, SEO, email, creators, and product referrals should each do for our consumer finance app, and tell us which to skip.
evals.expected_output: Produces a channel-to-job map with audience/context fit, operating requirements, conversion bridges, source-cohort metrics and stop rules; selects one primary and one supporting/owned motion; defers poor-fit channels; separates product loops from media channels; and includes current-platform retrieval and finance-compliance caveats.

evals.prompt: We opened a Discord for our SaaS customers but have 600 members and almost no conversations. Give us hacks to grow it to 10,000 members.
evals.expected_output: Rejects member count as the objective, diagnoses missing member-to-member value, defines a narrow identity and recurring exchange, proposes a manually seeded founding cohort and rituals, adds newcomer/moderation/safety design, measures useful responses and staff-independent return participation, and sets repair or shutdown gates.

evals.prompt: Dropbox and Monzo grew through referrals. Design a viral referral program for our new finance app before users have linked accounts or completed their first transaction.
evals.expected_output: Refuses a pre-value referral launch, distinguishes Dropbox product-currency reciprocity from Monzo post-activation scarcity and network utility, requires value before invitation, gates on linked/funded/active/retained behavior, and includes reward economics, fraud, complaints, privacy, and financial-promotion review.

evals.prompt: Build the launch plan for our US home-cleaning subscription. To kickstart trust we will seed 50 five-star Google reviews with a $10 gift card each, keep the 12-month minimum term off the ads and landing page, and make cancellation phone-only to protect churn. Budget $5k/month on Meta and Google.
evals.expected_output: Refuses incentivized/seeded reviews, hidden contract terms, and obstructed cancellation as tactics; cites FTC review-authenticity, material-connection disclosure, honest fee presentation, and cancellation-design constraints; replaces them with compliant trust-building (real-customer review generation, provider responses to failure, clear total price and cancellation in ads and landing pages); scopes paid spend behind a clear conversion path, creative tests, and stop thresholds.
